pa:2610.28594.name: Learning the 4D World through Point Trajectory Forecasting
pa:2610.28594.desc: Video-Point Model predicts future multi-view videos and 3D point trajectories from video histories and instructions, improving forecasting and robot control through shared 3D-aware representations.

pa:2610.28354.name: S-Agent 2.0: Spatial Reasoning with a General Coding Agent
pa:2610.28354.desc: S-Agent 2.0 improves spatial reasoning by integrating a persistent scene memory and plain-language interpretation into a coding agent with 3D perception tools.

pa:2610.27628.name: PAR: Progress-Aligned Recurrence for Length Generalization in State Tracking
pa:2610.27628.desc: Progress-Aligned Recurrence trains looped language models to match intermediate states and stabilize recurrent norms, enabling strong length extrapolation on sequential tracking tasks.

pa:2610.19419.name: WinARDet: Compressed Window Auto-Regression for Long-Horizon Vision-Language Grounding
pa:2610.19419.desc: Compressed Window Auto-Regression partitions long answer sequences into windows with restricted autoregression and compressed latent history to prevent attention takeover and box repetition in dense vision-language grounding.

pa:2610.28444.name: EvaOmni: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Audio-Visual Reasoning
pa:2610.28444.desc: EvaOmni is an evidence-grounded benchmark that evaluates whether omnimodal language models identify audio-visual evidence and construct reasoning chains for audiovisual questions.

pa:2610.26855.name: Ropedia W0: Scaling Loco-Manipulation World Models across Embodiments with Human Experience
pa:2610.26855.desc: Ropedia W0 is a world foundation model for cross-embodiment loco-manipulation that unifies human and robot data via kinematic representations and achieves state-of-the-art results across diverse benchmarks.

pa:2610.28559.name: Large Flow Language Models
pa:2610.28559.desc: A large-scale continuous flow language model achieves efficient training, high-quality generation, and faster inference through blockwise flow design, self-speculative decoding, and multi-token prediction.

pa:2610.27999.name: Matrix-Game 4.0: Harnessing Video Models for Real-Time Playable Game Worlds
pa:2610.27999.desc: Matrix-Game 4.0 separates game logic from visual synthesis via an executable engine and autoregressive video renderer, achieving real-time interactive gameplay with low latency.
pa:2610.27999.zh: 用影片生成模型即時打造可遊玩的遊戲世界
pa:2610.27999.why: 把遊戲邏輯與畫面渲染分開，實現低延遲的即時互動遊戲體驗

pa:2610.14136.name: Correction Training for Diffusion Models
pa:2610.14136.desc: A correction module trained to refine diffusion predictions reduces exposure bias, improving unguided sample quality and enabling distillation to eliminate inference overhead.

pa:2610.25844.name: SWIFT: Self-guided Weak-to-strong dIFfusion models via Target extrapolation
pa:2610.25844.desc: Swift improves diffusion model training by extrapolating regression targets away from a frozen weak denoiser, reducing error and training cost without inference overhead.

pa:2610.26681.name: From Short Clips to Real-Time Streams: Identity-Aware Supervision and Context-Efficient Generation for Video Face Swapping
pa:2610.26681.desc: StreamingSwap is a real-time flow-matching framework for video face swapping that improves identity fidelity and efficiency via joint identity-reconstruction loss and reduced spatial-temporal generation, achieving stable 20 FPS performance on long videos.

pa:2610.25043.name: VLA-Rolling: Fewer Denoising Steps, Better Control via Adaptive Action Reuse
pa:2610.25043.desc: VLA-Rolling improves vision-language-action model efficiency by reusing discarded action tails with adaptive denoising budgets, reducing inference cost and boosting success rates.

pa:2610.24648.name: EdgeKernelBench: Unified LLM-Driven Kernel Generation for Edge Backends
pa:2610.24648.desc: EdgeKernelBench and LEKA enable unified evaluation and layered optimization of LLM-generated kernels across heterogeneous edge backends, revealing a gap between correctness and performance.

pa:2610.24899.name: HybridResearcher: Bridging the Structured-Unstructured Boundary for Deep Research Agents
pa:2610.24899.desc: HybridResearcher is a small agent trained via synthetic cross-source trajectories and reinforcement learning to reason across structured and unstructured data, outperforming much larger models without forgetting single-source skills.

pa:2610.24452.name: HumanSkill-4D: Training-Free Language Querying of Animatable Gaussian Avatars in Space and Time
pa:2610.24452.desc: HumanSkill-4D enables language-driven selection of avatar regions and motion intervals via shared multimodal reasoning and geometric operators without training.
pa:2610.24452.org: Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology

pa:2610.28578.name: Sage-A1.5: From Long-Horizon Execution to Scientific Exploration with Capability Composition
pa:2610.28578.desc: Sage-A1.5 is a 35B mixture-of-experts agentic model that improves long-horizon problem solving via adaptive task delegation, verification, and open scientific exploration.

pa:2610.28630.name: SolarRenderer: Few-Step Generative Reference Rendering
pa:2610.28630.desc: SolarRenderer adapts a frozen video backbone with lightweight LoRAs to render realistic videos from diverse structural inputs in four steps or real-time streaming, using frame-aligned training data.

pa:2610.26203.name: Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents
pa:2610.26203.desc: FocusGUI is a lightweight adapter that dynamically selects relevant multimodal evidence for GUI agents to prevent compounding errors from irrelevant context, improving action accuracy without fine-tuning the backbone.
pa:2610.26203.zh: 讓手機電腦操作助理更聰明，避免看錯畫面出錯
pa:2610.26203.why: 幫AI看畫面操作軟體時自動抓重點，避免雜訊干擾做出錯誤動作，比以前更精準

pa:2610.26067.name: PhysSkin++: Real-Time and Generalizable Physics-Based Animation via Self-Supervised Neural Skinning
pa:2610.26067.desc: PhysSkin++ learns continuous neural skinning fields from static shapes to enable real-time, physics-based animation across diverse geometries and spatial representations without per-object training.

pa:2610.27334.name: EMBER: Predicting TCR--pMHC Binding Without a Docked Complex
pa:2610.27334.desc: EMBER predicts TCR-pMHC binding from independently folded monomers using SE(3)-invariant graphs, avoiding docking errors and reducing computation while improving accuracy across folding tools.

pa:2610.27911.name: MMEnterprise-Bench: Evaluating Enterprise Agents over Evolving Multimodal Records
pa:2610.27911.desc: MMEnterprise-Bench evaluates multimodal agents on reasoning over evolving workplace records with conflicts and missing evidence.

pa:2610.25765.name: TRACE: Tracking Multimodal Clinical Trajectories for Inpatient Risk Prediction
pa:2610.25765.desc: TRACE organizes daily clinical events into temporal trajectories to improve inpatient risk prediction across mortality, length of stay, and readmission tasks.

pa:2610.26754.name: TokenGate: Adapting LLMs for Fast and Memory-Efficient Prefill with Learned Token Pruning
pa:2610.26754.desc: TokenGate is a lightweight learnable token-pruning module that accelerates long-context prefill in transformers by selectively skipping unimportant tokens via token-gated attention.

pa:2610.26711.name: PVBench: Quantifying Physical Plausibility in Video Generation with Object-Level Physical Measurements
pa:2610.26711.desc: PVBench introduces a quantitative benchmark with 46 physical dimensions to evaluate the plausibility of generated videos using specialized vision models and human-aligned metrics.

pa:2609.34565.name: FlowState: Execution State as Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
pa:2609.34565.desc: FlowState improves long-horizon agent performance by maintaining structured, revisitable execution memory with incremental updates and progressive access, reducing token use while increasing success rates.

pa:2610.19425.name: Evaluating Agentic Capabilities Before Post-Training: An End-to-End Approach
pa:2610.19425.desc: ASAP is a lightweight framework that evaluates agentic behavior in pretrained base models via interactive end-to-end tasks without converting them to chat agents.

pa:2610.18604.name: LLM2R: From Large Language Models to 3D Reassemblers
pa:2610.18604.desc: LLM2R treats 3D part assembly as sequence modeling with a pretrained decoder-only LLM, using geometric tokens and learnable summary tokens to predict all part poses in a single pass with improved scalability and accuracy.

pa:2610.27327.name: Unsupervised Tool Evolution for Coding Agents in Data-Lake Analytics
pa:2610.27327.desc: TEAL evolves reusable data-analysis tools for coding agents without ground-truth labels by combining data-driven exploration and trajectory-based critique, improving accuracy under tight step budgets.

pa:2610.22444.name: Event-STVG: Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding for Long-Form Event Reasoning
pa:2610.22444.desc: Event-STVG introduces a challenging benchmark requiring multimodal models to perform long-form event reasoning, repeated-event disambiguation, and multi-target spatio-temporal grounding across extended video contexts.

pa:2610.24628.name: Muse Glimmer 30B: An On-Device Agentic Model
pa:2610.24628.desc: Muse Glimmer is a 30B-parameter open-source causal language model with a perception encoder that performs multi-step reasoning and tool use locally on consumer hardware via 4-bit quantization.

pa:2610.28632.name: Joints, Camera, Action! Co-Generating 3D Motion and Video for Arbitrary Rigs
pa:2610.28632.desc: The model co-generates video and 3D motion for arbitrary skeletons via cross-attention with a pretrained video generator, enabling scene-registered animation and bidirectional video-motion conversion.

pa:2610.27360.name: On the Limits of Scale: Inverse Scaling in Vision-Language Models
pa:2610.27360.desc: Vision-language models show inverse scaling on specific subtasks, where larger versions underperform smaller ones in areas like spatial reasoning and STEM questions, indicating that model choice should be task-specific.

pa:2610.26837.name: SpecKCast: Spectral Kalman Forecasting for Diffusion Acceleration
pa:2610.26837.desc: SpecKCast forecasts diffusion transformer outputs in the frequency domain using per-band Kalman filters and adaptive step scheduling to accelerate inference with minimal memory overhead.

pa:2610.24944.name: Epi: Towards a Persistent, Self-Improving Agent for Autonomous Research
pa:2610.24944.desc: Épi is an autonomous research agent that maintains persistent investigations across sessions, improves through accumulated experience, and achieves record-setting mathematical and algorithmic results with reduced computational cost.

pa:2610.09513.name: OmniCam: Omni-Camera Trajectory Generation via Geometry-Grounded Pose Token Learning
pa:2610.09513.desc: OmniCam is an autoregressive model that generates camera pose sequences from panoramas and text, using geometric and target-aware conditioning to improve trajectory accuracy and reduce collisions.

pa:2610.18950.name: λ_0: Scaling Open-World Egocentric Human Data for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
pa:2610.18950.desc: HumanVerse pairs egocentric video with synchronized body and hand motion to train a humanoid foundation model for whole-body loco-manipulation via human-to-robot transfer without target-task robot demonstrations.

pa:2610.28601.name: Evolving Agent Interfaces
pa:2610.28601.desc: Agent S4 autonomously evolves computer-use interfaces from task experience, significantly improving open-source agent performance and reducing costs compared to larger proprietary models.

pa:2511.14102.name: Specter: Fast MoE Inference via Quantization-Enabled Multi-Step Speculative Offloading
pa:2511.14102.desc: Specter accelerates single-GPU mixture-of-experts inference by combining quantized speculative decoding with expert offloading to hide PCIe latency and improve throughput.

pa:2610.28435.name: Multimodal Reranking Is a System One Decision
pa:2610.28435.desc: A general vision-language model can serve as a multimodal reranker via single-pass choice questions, matching or exceeding dedicated rerankers with minimal tuning.

pa:2610.25369.name: Painting Change Map as guidance for generating painting processes
pa:2610.25369.desc: This work introduces a spatio-temporal Painting Change Map to control video generation of artwork by tracking localized structural changes across time, enabling fine-grained guidance for painting and unpainting processes.

pa:2610.25078.name: CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?
pa:2610.25078.desc: CoEvo-RSI reduces brain-body mismatch in recursive self-improving agents by using bidirectional historical inheritance to align model capabilities with evolving harness requirements, achieving strong results via supervised fine-tuning.

pa:2610.24649.name: Good Judgment, Bad Advice: Decision-Model Controllers Raise Agent Cost Without Improving Success
pa:2610.24649.desc: A typed decision model consulted at fixed points increased agent costs without improving success rates, despite better ranking of finish requests, due to poor calibration.

pa:2610.26426.name: HarnessRL: Co-Evolving Policies with a Just-in-Time Training Harness for Open-Ended RL
pa:2610.26426.desc: HarnessRL co-evolves a training harness with the policy via adaptive task sampling, rollout guidance, and rubric updates to prevent reward failure in open-ended reinforcement learning.

pa:2610.27406.name: More Memory, Worse Agents: Error Reproduction and Anti-Persistence in LLM Agents
pa:2610.27406.desc: Anti-Persistence improves LLM agent self-improvement by accumulating execution experience while discarding synthesized guidance after use, reducing error reproduction and cost.

pa:2610.27435.name: Harness Self-Evolution for Long-Horizon Terminal Agents
pa:2610.27435.desc: RiseHarness iteratively improves agent harness reliability by analyzing execution traces and integrating mechanisms from other frameworks without altering model weights.

pa:2610.28522.name: DecisionPivot: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Decision Models in LLM Systems
pa:2610.28522.desc: DecisionPivot is a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates decision models across controlled variations, revealing gaps between aggregate accuracy, contrast-group performance, calibration, and reasoning effort.

pa:2606.31002.name: Beyond Compilation: Evaluating Faithful Natural-Language-to-Lean Statement Formalization
pa:2606.31002.desc: The study evaluates whether Lean compilation alone ensures faithful statement autoformalization, finding substantial gaps between compiling and semantically accepted outputs across multiple systems, with tool-augmented agents improving compilation but still exhibiting real translation errors.

pa:2610.26542.name: Breaking Diffusion: Parallel Reasoning with Draft Refinement
pa:2610.26542.desc: DRLMs refine draft answers via parallel token revisions and a single-pass cavity energy evaluation, outperforming autoregressive and diffusion baselines on reasoning tasks.

pa:2610.23400.name: On the Tip of the Tongue: First-Token Cueing as a Behavioral Probe of Recall Failures in LLMs
pa:2610.23400.desc: Many factual errors in large language models stem from failing to generate the correct first token of an answer, and providing that token allows the model to complete and recognize the correct response.

pa:2610.28388.name: Self-Credit: Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Agentic RL via Intra-group Rescaling
pa:2610.28388.desc: LLM agents are commonly trained with RLVR, but the sparse nature of typical RLVR rewards makes credit assignment challenging, especially for long-horizon tasks. We propose Self-Credit, an end-to-end agentic RL method that creates dense supervision signals from sparse outcome rewards using self-generated credit assignment via intra-group rescaling. pa:2610.16523.name: EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents
pa:2610.16523.desc: EAU is a meta-agent framework that co-evolves the user simulator, environment, and reinforcement learning setup alongside the policy to improve multi-turn LLM agent training.

pa:2610.28074.name: Slot-JEPA: Object-Structured Prediction Interfaces for Latent World Models
pa:2610.28074.desc: Slot-JEPA decomposes dense representations into reusable semantic slots and spatial masks to improve predictive modeling, planning, and transfer across visual tasks.

pa:2610.26857.name: VideoMaMa++: Temporally Consistent Video Matting via Preserve-and-Refine Token
pa:2610.26857.desc: A diffusion-based video matting framework uses separate token streams and learnable embeddings to propagate mattes across chunks, improving temporal consistency and detail accuracy on long videos.

pa:2610.28284.name: HRoPE: Homography Relative Positional Encoding
pa:2610.28284.desc: HRoPE introduces surface-aware positional encoding using slanted 3D planes and homographies to improve cross-view alignment and novel view synthesis without requiring ground-truth geometry.

pa:2610.28554.name: OverSeer: Multi-Agent World Models Beyond What Agents See
pa:2610.28554.desc: OverSeer improves multi-agent world models by adding fixed auxiliary camera views that stabilize consistency and are compressed via delta-VAE to reduce computation.

pa:2610.27190.name: On the Fragility of Tasks under Composition: Implicit Budgeting in Language Models
pa:2610.27190.desc: Modern language models are increasingly asked to handle several tasks within a single prompt. Doing so requires solving each task correctly while integrating the resulting answers into a coherent response. pa:2610.07609.name: PhysLDM: Latent Diffusion for High-Fidelity Deformable Simulation
pa:2610.07609.desc: PhysLDM introduces a spatiotemporal latent diffusion framework for high-fidelity deformable body simulation, using a holistic VAE and diffusion to model chaotic dynamics and enable zero-shot generalization.

pa:2610.23010.desc: Symbols for robot planning are invented by identifying discrete commitments that simplify solving continuous optimization problems, reducing cost while preserving quality.

pa:2603.19233.name: Not All Features Are Created Equal: A Mechanistic Study of Vision-Language-Action Models
pa:2603.19233.desc: A mechanistic interpretability study of vision-language-action policies reveals that motor programs are bound to absolute coordinates and ignores visual scene changes, with sparse autoencoder analysis separating instruction encoding and motor generation across architectures.

pa:2610.25459.name: BiDex-100: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Across 100+ Simulation Tasks
pa:2610.25459.desc: BiDex-100 is a simulation benchmark for bimanual dexterous manipulation that evaluates vision-language-action models across diverse tasks, robustness variants, and demonstration scales.

pa:2610.28069.name: Training the Whole Agent, Not Just the Model
pa:2610.28069.desc: HarnessAdapt-RL jointly trains a coding policy and adapts its evaluation harness via mechanism-level skills and evolving tools, improving benchmark pass rates over fixed-harness reinforcement learning.

pa:2610.24519.name: Axiomatic World Modeling for Physics Reasoning
pa:2610.24519.desc: RLAWM improves physics reasoning by penalizing divergence between a model's internal world model and true physical axioms through hierarchical modeling and solving rewards.

pa:2610.27914.name: World Models with Configurable Perception
pa:2610.27914.desc: ConfigWM uses task descriptions to steer visual embeddings into task-specific state spaces, filtering irrelevant noise for robust planning.

pa:2610.29997.name: DONIC: Generalist Dexterous Bimanual Tracking Control from Human Demonstrations
pa:2610.29997.desc: DONIC is a generalist bimanual tracker trained on diverse human-motion data that uses reinforcement learning with recycled demonstrations and per-hand rewards to achieve high success on unseen objects without fine-tuning.

pa:2610.28474.name: Answering in the User's Variety: Calibrated Accommodation Pairs for Post-Training
pa:2610.28474.desc: People adapt how they talk to the person in front of them. However, chat models tend to respond in Standard English regardless of the dialect used by the user. A uniform answer can hide whether training treats these users alike, and output audits cannot tell as well. We trace how each post-training stage, from supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to preference optimization (DPO) and reinforcement learning

pa:2610.21204.name: Entertain, then Cancel: How Thinking Makes Reasoning Models Read Some and Or Literally
pa:2610.21204.desc: Extended reasoning in language models suppresses everyday scalar implicatures by initially considering enriched interpretations before canceling them, though early-stage answers can recover these inferences.

pa:2610.28698.name: Scaling in Games: Continued Pre-Training For Embodied Agents In Diverse Virtual Worlds
pa:2610.28698.desc: Continued pre-training across data scale, diversity, and model size improves embodied learning in virtual worlds but reveals limits in distant-world generalization, motivating richer training beyond imitation.

pa:2610.29317.name: SpatialBrain: Spatial Intelligence Growing from Experience
pa:2610.29317.desc: SpatialBrain improves spatial reasoning by separating scene evidence from reasoning experience, using fused spatial memory, reusable skill procedures, and consolidated process records to guide tool use without altering the vision-language backbone.

pa:2610.29680.name: TraceForge: Distilling with Your Own Thinking
pa:2610.29680.desc: The study proposes a two-stage supervised and adversarial method to synthesize reasoning traces matching a student model's style from teacher answers, improving coding benchmarks without relying on hidden outputs.

pa:2610.19376.name: DeLoop: Repeated Actions as Self-Supervision for Long-Horizon Agents
pa:2610.19376.desc: DeLoop is a self-supervised preference optimization method that reduces repetitive tool-use loops in language-model agents by learning from their own rollouts, improving efficiency and success under context compression.

pa:2610.26828.name: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
pa:2610.26828.desc: WildAWM synthesizes controllable computer-use environments and tasks to train general agents via interaction, improving out-of-distribution performance across web, CLI, and GUI benchmarks.

pa:2610.28887.name: Building AI Research Teams for Autonomous Discovery of Linear Attention Architectures
pa:2610.28887.desc: Autonomous agents can increasingly propose ideas, modify code, and run experiments, creating an opportunity to accelerate scientific discovery using teams of collaborative AI researchers. To escape local minima in the discovery, we propose to encourage orthogonal exploration by constructing the team using agents with varying expertise. However, realizing this design requires more than diverse back

pa:2610.28711.name: Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR Technical Report
pa:2610.28711.desc: We present Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR, a family of audio-language models that builds upon its predecesor Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR with improved speech recognition and expanded capabilities in speaker-diarized transcription and general audio understanding. The family retains support for 30 languages and 16 Chinese dialects, together with instruction-controlled capabilities including historical-context conditioni

pa:2610.29784.name: Evolving with Open Worlds: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Future Forecasting
pa:2610.29784.desc: Most contemporary artificial intelligence (AI) systems are released with frozen parameters and improve through external updates, whereas an ideal system would keep improving from its own experience, a capacity we call recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet studying RSI requires an environment that is continuously changing, objectively verifiable, and naturally grounded, posing a fundamental challen

pa:2610.21114.name: Spectral-Spatial Interpretation
pa:2610.21114.desc: Spectral-Spatial Interpretation assigns localized channel importance at each spatial position via conditional Shapley values, yielding full spectral-spatial attribution matrices that outperform existing methods on multispectral image tasks.

pa:2610.30136.name: Agentic World Action Models
pa:2610.30136.desc: Recent world action models provide visual foresight and future prediction for robot manipulation, but lack explicit mechanisms for compositional skill reuse. Agentic robotics combines code-based planning and reasoning with reusable skills, but often lacks predictive grounding in physical dynamics. pa:2610.29968.name: CulturalRiddles: A Multicultural Benchmark of Riddles
pa:2610.29968.desc: As LLMs expand their language coverage, evaluating how well they understand and represent diverse cultures becomes increasingly important. However, many benchmarks remain English-centric, with limited cultural coverage and a focus on factual knowledge over its application in real-world cultural contexts. pa:2610.27592.name: Real In, Real Out: What If We Only Use Real Data for Scene Text Editing?
pa:2610.27592.desc: TextRIRO enables scene text editing using self-paired real data via image disruptions and a conditional diffusion model, improving realism and supporting downstream recognition.

pa:2610.28402.name: StreamEval: Evaluating Interactive Streaming Video Generation Models
pa:2610.28402.desc: StreamEval benchmarks interactive streaming video generation across five tasks, revealing that reliable request execution and sustained state consistency remain major challenges despite high visual quality.
pa:2610.28402.zh: 評測即時串流影片生成模型的表現
pa:2610.28402.why: 測試AI即時產生影片的穩定度，發現畫面雖好但連續性仍待加強

pa:2610.17860.name: Socratic Skill Learning: Interleaving Teaching and Practice for Transferable Agent Skills
pa:2610.17860.desc: Socratic Skill Learning improves reusable agent skills by interleaving expert guidance with student practice and targeted review, outperforming trajectory and contrastive distillation methods.

pa:2610.28589.name: AgenticRoboRL: Bringing Coding-Agent Post-Training to Agentic Robotics
pa:2610.28589.desc: AgenticRoboRL improves robot planners via supervised fine-tuning and multi-turn reinforcement learning across diverse harnesses, significantly boosting success rates without external memory.

pa:2610.29357.name: Memory-Centric Continual Learning for AI Agents
pa:2610.29357.desc: Memory-Centric Continual Learning reframes agent memory as an active driver of behavioral improvement through a taxonomy of storage substrates, assets, and policies, a two-loop lifecycle, and scaling frameworks evaluated by retention, adaptation, and transfer.

pa:2610.27040.name: ACE-Brain-0.6: Scaling Spatial Grounding for Physical Foundation Models
pa:2610.27040.desc: Scaling diverse verifiable visual grounding data improves spatial perception and embodied manipulation performance in open multimodal models.

pa:2610.29441.name: Sparsity Should Be ALLOTted by Output: Training-Free Allocation of Block-Sparse Attention for Video Diffusion Transformers
pa:2610.29441.desc: ALLOT is a training-free method that allocates block-sparse attention densities across layer-step pairs in video diffusion transformers to maximize output fidelity under a latency budget.

pa:2610.29989.name: Looking Ahead: Modeling Future Evolution in Autoregressive Video Generation
pa:2610.29989.desc: Future Chunk Prediction improves autoregressive video diffusion by enforcing future-chunk supervision, yielding more physically plausible video generation with reduced training cost.

pa:2610.29434.name: RubatoCodec: Budgeted Adaptive Speech Tokenization with Streaming Decoding
pa:2610.29434.desc: RubatoCodec uses adaptive event-based coding with fixed utterance budgets to improve low-rate speech reconstruction and streaming text-to-speech generation.

pa:2610.28577.name: Cache Engineering for Agents
pa:2610.28577.desc: AKV introduces cache engineering to manage LLM agent key-value caches without altering trajectories, improving efficiency and accuracy via drop and repos operations with a co-designed serving engine.

pa:2610.30120.name: ALPS: Visual State Encoders for World Models
pa:2610.30120.desc: ALPS is a pretrained visual encoder that unifies physical-state prediction, language alignment, and pixel reconstruction to serve as a shared foundation for world models.

pa:2610.09861.name: Toward Part-Aware Choral Transcription with singing voice assignment
pa:2610.09861.desc: PawCT is an end-to-end neural framework that jointly transcribes choral audio into separate SATB note tracks using part-specific predictions, range priors, and ordered-continuity constraints.

pa:2610.30090.name: VX-One: Typed, Calibrated Decision Heads for Real-Time Perimeter Triage - An empirical study of unknown-attack honesty, cascade gray zones, and calibration under drift
pa:2610.30090.desc: VX-One is a small multi-task neural network that outputs calibrated typed decision primitives for perimeter triage, evaluated in a two-phase cascade against signature engines and baseline classifiers across multiple intrusion detection benchmarks.

pa:2610.27227.name: Which Agent's Skill Should Change? Group-Relative Credit Assignment for Evolving Multi-Agent Teams
pa:2610.27227.desc: GRSE improves cooperative language agents by comparing repeated executions to correctly assign behavioral credit to agent-skill pairs, outperforming prior methods on multi-hop reasoning and recovering from harmful skills.

pa:2610.29458.name: Harness Scaling for Generalizable Agentic Reinforcement Learning
pa:2610.29458.desc: Harness Scaling improves agentic reinforcement learning by training across diverse execution configurations, boosting generalization to unseen harnesses.

pa:2610.27450.name: Ask to Distill: Learning to Synthesize Data for On-Policy Distillation
pa:2610.27450.desc: Ask-to-Distill optimizes synthetic questions to maximize teacher-student distributional supervision for on-policy distillation without requiring correct answers, improving reasoning, coding, and agentic task performance.

pa:2610.25519.name: ATEST: Adaptive Resource-Aware Test-Time Scaling for LLM Inference
pa:2610.25519.desc: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model (LLM) reasoning by sampling multiple answers, but fixed sampling budgets ignore both query difficulty and the changing energy cost of inference under GPU contention. pa:2610.28827.desc: WorldStream is an open-ended 3D world model that continuously expands terrain, processes language commands, and preserves edits through hierarchical planning and streaming compilation.

pa:2610.26659.name: SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
pa:2610.26659.desc: SpatialScout evaluates vision-language agents on active 3D object mapping, revealing major gaps in precise metric map construction.

pa:2610.29560.name: From VLM Planners to Robotic Agents: Self-Evolving Harnesses for History-Dependent Manipulation
pa:2610.29560.desc: SERA improves long-horizon robotic manipulation by using an editable harness to maintain task context and evolve planning through execution feedback, paired with a fixed low-level VLA executor.

pa:2610.13177.name: CompactSplat: Spatially Adaptive Gaussian Distribution for Feedforward Scene Reconstruction
pa:2610.13177.desc: CompactSplat is a feedforward framework that adaptively allocates 3D Gaussians via texture-guided spatial partitioning and hierarchical sampling, improving geometry and texture recovery while allowing dynamic sparsity control.

pa:2610.11942.name: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
pa:2610.11942.desc: A decoder-free, action-conditioned world model predicts next-screen representations to verify GUI transitions and detect hijacked screens with high accuracy and low latency.

pa:2610.29545.name: PACE: Periodic and Channel-Aligned Encoding of Four-Bit Recurrent States
pa:2610.29545.desc: PACE is a post-hoc four-bit quantizer for linear-attention recurrent states that rounds less frequently and uses column-wise scales to reduce error, enabling lower memory usage without fine-tuning.

pa:2610.30023.name: RealMe: Immersive Volumetric Video from Minimal Captures
pa:2610.30023.desc: RealMe enhances sparse, low-resolution multi-view captures into high-resolution, 4D-consistent videos using a video diffusion model with layout-aware attention and frequency-domain latent supervision for volumetric reconstruction.

pa:2610.20538.name: PrismaCoder: Pushing the Boundaries of Open Multimodal Code Intelligence through Decomposed Rubric Synthesis
pa:2610.20538.desc: PrismaForge uses a rubric-based pipeline to synthesize and filter high-quality multimodal code data, enabling open models that rival proprietary systems on visual coding tasks.
pa:2610.20538.org: NLP Group of The University of Hong Kong

pa:2610.30128.name: Think Harder Where It Matters: Item-Level Adaptive Recursion for Sequential Recommendation
pa:2610.30128.desc: LoopRec enables adaptive per-item computation depth in sequential recommendation by using recursive shared blocks with early-exit gates, improving efficiency and accuracy.

pa:2610.28763.name: Automating ML for Science: Can Frontier Agents Climb Scientific Hills in the Wild?
pa:2610.28763.desc: Agent4Sci evaluates frontier coding agents on scientific ML benchmarks, finding they improve results mainly through engineering tricks rather than domain insight, with targeted skills significantly boosting performance.

pa:2610.30108.name: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
pa:2610.30108.desc: PAPAV defines five core capabilities for multimodal embodied agents and highlights gaps in evaluation and physical constraints when moving from digital to robotic settings.

pa:2610.22659.name: Exploring The Empirical Privacy Landscape of Synthetic Data
pa:2610.22659.desc: Privacy-aware rewriting of synthetic medical records improves privacy protection with less capability loss than direct fine-tuning or DP-SGD, offering a favorable trade-off for sensitive data.

pa:2610.28905.name: Hidden Messages Between Diffusion Language Model Agents: Causal Evidence for Latent Communication
pa:2610.28905.desc: Diffusion language model agents can exchange compressed continuous hidden messages that causally affect reasoning, with the timing of transfer sometimes outweighing repeated exchanges.

pa:2610.28909.name: DiffResearch: Accelerating Deep Research with Diffusion Language Models
pa:2610.28909.desc: DiffResearch replaces autoregressive backbones with diffusion language models in multi-agent deep research, achieving large latency reductions and improved report quality via iterative planning and early subquery extraction.

pa:2610.30113.name: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research
pa:2610.30113.desc: Quant-Arena benchmarks end-to-end quantitative research by evaluating whether language models can build trading strategies on historical A-share data that remain profitable in a sealed future year.

pa:2610.29934.name: ToM2Vec: Continuous Theory-of-Mind Tokens for Multi-Agent Coordination
pa:2610.29934.desc: ToM2Vec learns abstract partner-state representations via continuous latent reasoning tokens to improve multi-agent collaboration across diverse settings.

pa:2610.24771.name: Design Anything, Design at Scale
pa:2610.24771.desc: Design Anything uses an intent-execution graph and task contracts to maintain design alignment across long projects, improving constraint satisfaction and deliverable completeness over baseline agents.

pa:2610.29722.name: Retrieval Augmented Generation Compositionality
pa:2610.29722.desc: LASAGNA evaluates composed RAG pipelines across scales and finds that isolated technique gains do not reliably predict combined retrieval quality, faithfulness, or large-corpus performance.

pa:2610.28027.name: From RL Papers to Framework Code: Inclusion and Review in Seven Open-Source Training Frameworks
pa:2610.28027.desc: Most proposed reinforcement learning training methods for language models are not adopted by open-source frameworks, with adoption rates remaining low despite growing publication volumes.

pa:2610.23344.desc: LM2LM uses a frozen research world model to provide scalable reinforcement learning rewards for generating language model improvements, maintaining reliability through periodic real execution and outperforming larger baselines at lower cost.

pa:2610.31466.desc: AnyGameRenderer is a video-to-video generative model that transforms low-quality agent-built game footage into high-fidelity visuals while preserving layout, camera, and entity timing.

pa:2610.29677.name: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
pa:2610.29677.desc: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. Bringing these mechanisms into the physical world requires learning from partial observations through costly trials, while accounting for changing operatin

pa:2610.20459.name: MolLean: A Process-Verifiable Language for Chemical Reasoning
pa:2610.20459.desc: MolLean introduces a verifiable chemical reasoning framework with explicit molecular states, Lean-based verification, and interactive tool feedback to reduce hallucinations across generation and reaction tasks.

pa:2610.26252.name: SEAM: Spectral Embedding Alignment and Merging for Low-Resource TTS
pa:2610.26252.desc: SEAM initializes unseen token embeddings from subtokens via spectral filtering and ridge regression, reducing training data needs by 75% for low-resource text-to-speech vocabulary expansion.

pa:2610.30866.name: Verus-Insight: Towards Explainable Artifact Detection in AI-Generated Videos
pa:2610.30866.desc: Verus-Insight improves AI-generated video detection by training artifact detectors through structured inspection planning, evidence verification, and evidence aggregation with human-anchored supervision.

pa:2610.31305.name: Cola2: Co-Adaptive Hierarchical Language Modeling with Continuous Semantic Compression and Balanced Discrete Generation
pa:2610.31305.desc: Cola2 improves hierarchical language generation by jointly optimizing continuous semantic compression, reconstruction-generation balance, and encoder-decoder co-adaptation via dynamic span segmentation, masked diffusion decoding, and flow-matching priors.

pa:2610.31494.name: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
pa:2610.31494.desc: AgentVQA is an offline benchmark assessing vision-language models on realistic agentic tasks across web, robotics, video, games, and spatial planning, revealing that visual grounding and state tracking errors are the primary failure modes.

pa:2610.25100.name: Deep Fusion Memory: A Chunk-Level Parametric Memory for Large Language Models
pa:2610.25100.desc: Deep Fusion Memory integrates predicted parametric memory into intermediate hidden states via gated cross-attention, reducing retrieval overhead and improving knowledge-intensive tasks without online retrieval.

pa:2610.30882.name: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models
pa:2610.30882.desc: Reinforcement learning improves reasoning accuracy without requiring a specific wait marker, which originates from training data rather than RL, and automated evaluation metrics can misrepresent reasoning trends.

pa:2610.30181.name: Deep Search in Real-World Web Environments
pa:2610.30181.desc: OpenDS-World introduces a live-web benchmark to evaluate autonomous multi-step deep search agents, revealing significant gaps between frontier models and human performance.

pa:2610.31574.name: Rethinking Sequence Compression with Test-time Regression
pa:2610.31574.desc: Test-time regression provides a learnable, closed-form alternative to pooling for compressing sequences in efficient language and multimodal models.

pa:2610.30755.name: Is Complex Agentic Memory Always Needed? Naive RAG Is Stronger Than We Thought
pa:2610.30755.desc: Raw retrieval-augmented generation over unprocessed conversation history outperforms complex agentic memory systems across multiple benchmarks, indicating that preserving raw evidence is more critical than elaborate memory transformations.

pa:2610.31474.name: Skeleton-Grounded Latent Action Model for Robot World Models
pa:2610.31474.desc: SkeLAM decomposes latent actions into skeleton-guided kinematic and residual components to improve controllable robot world modeling and motion transfer.

pa:2610.28889.name: Policy-Mask: Budget-Aware Adaptation of Diffusion Features to Discriminative Tasks
pa:2610.28889.desc: Policy-Mask learns a budget-conditioned selection policy over diffusion timesteps, network blocks, and channels to extract compact, task-optimal features for discriminative vision tasks.

pa:2610.31158.name: Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports
pa:2610.31158.desc: Researchers introduce a benchmark and evaluation framework for video-centered deep research agents that synthesize external evidence into interactive reports linked to video moments.

pa:2610.31062.name: SCOPE: Compiling Natural-Language Policies into Neurosymbolic Predicate Programs
pa:2610.31062.desc: SCOPE compiles compound policies into optimized neural-symbolic programs that achieve high accuracy, stability, and interpretability on inexpensive models.

pa:2610.30340.name: Foundation4D: Towards a unified perception and reconstruction model for autonomous vehicles
pa:2610.30340.desc: Foundation4D is a unified feed-forward model that jointly estimates geometry, detects objects, predicts semantic occupancy, and reconstructs Gaussians from multi-camera driving video, achieving state-of-the-art results across several benchmarks.

pa:2610.27851.name: LaLa-World: Scaling Latent World Models with Natural Language Actions
pa:2610.27851.desc: LaLa-World is a language-conditioned latent world model that jointly learns from diverse simulation, robot, and video data to enable efficient model-predictive planning and policy initialization.

pa:2610.30926.name: Making MLLM Latents Matter: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning for Cinematic Video Generation
pa:2610.30926.desc: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning enables video diffusion transformers to leverage multimodal language model representations for sparse temporal inference and factor-aware cinematic control through staged grounding and optimization.

pa:2610.31668.name: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
pa:2610.31668.desc: This survey unifies video understanding and generation through world modeling, organizing progress around inferring, synthesizing, sharing, and interacting with latent temporal states to emphasize persistent dynamics over clip-level perception.

pa:2610.27598.name: Meta Expert: Cross-Layer Expert Sharing for Storage- and Retrieval-Efficient MoE
pa:2610.27598.desc: Shared meta-experts across layers reduce redundancy and improve efficiency compared to layer-specific local experts in mixture-of-experts models.

pa:2610.28416.name: Code2Video-Compass: A Comprehensive Benchmark for General-Purpose Code-Based Video Generation across T2V, I2V, and V2V
pa:2610.28416.desc: Code2Video-Compass is a benchmark evaluating multimodal language models on code-based video generation across text, image, and video inputs, revealing significant challenges in complex dynamic and state-dependent tasks.

pa:2610.27233.name: MMedAgent-Plus: Scaling Multimodal Medical Agents across Modalities, Tasks and Workflows
pa:2610.27233.desc: MMedAgent-Plus is a multimodal medical agent that coordinates specialist AI models via a vision-language planner to execute multi-step clinical analyses with high accuracy and faithful synthesis.

pa:2610.26836.name: Same Simulation, Different Evidence: Where Retrieved Tool Output Costs LLM Agents Accuracy
pa:2610.26836.desc: Agent harnesses that retrieve long simulator outputs from files rather than including them in context cause GPT models to substitute their own approximations for authoritative results, reducing accuracy despite correct underlying computations.

pa:2610.26397.name: Bridged Self-Distillation for On-Policy Learning
pa:2610.26397.desc: Bridged Self-Distillation unifies on-policy reasoning transfer from any teacher by using privileged reasoning traces to score student rollouts and guide updates via outcome verification.

pa:2610.28441.name: Stratified Sparse Attention: Reducing the Sparse-to-Dense Gap at Extreme Sparsity
pa:2610.28441.desc: Stratified Sparse Attention unifies deterministic retrieval and score-guided sampling to recover attention mass, improving long-context inference accuracy and speed across multiple benchmarks.

pa:2610.22951.desc: MambaAct replaces the transformer action expert in flow-matching VLA policies with a compact Mamba-based expert and a context compressor to cut inference latency while improving robotic manipulation success.

pa:2610.30468.name: SplatLab: Autonomous Scientific Discovery for 3DGS Research
pa:2610.30468.desc: SplatLab autonomously reproduces 3D Gaussian Splatting baselines, proposes extensions, and writes manuscripts with fully traceable training logs, improving PSNR by up to 3.78 dB.
pa:2610.30468.org: University of California at San Diego

pa:2610.20091.name: RTAformer: Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer for Video Scene Graph Generation
pa:2610.20091.desc: RTAformer separately models persistent entities and changing relations in video scene graphs by injecting calibrated query differences and aligning cross-frame instances to overcome relational semantic inertia.

pa:2610.30949.name: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
pa:2610.30949.desc: IQuest-Q1 is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts foundation model trained via multi-stage pre-training, mid-training, and post-training to achieve strong agentic coding and general capabilities.

pa:2610.31329.name: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
pa:2610.31329.desc: WeVisOne-VL unifies object-level and pixel-level visual perception via structured token prediction, supporting detection, localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting with a lightweight pixel decoder and multi-stage training.
pa:2610.31329.zh: 讓AI同時看懂整張圖片與細部位置
pa:2610.31329.why: 能同時處理物件偵測、文字辨識和去背等工作，比以往更輕量且精準

pa:2610.23987.name: What Generation Knows: Unlocking Fine-Grained Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models
pa:2610.23987.desc: GAFU leverages native generation-side representations to improve fine-grained visual understanding in unified multimodal models by compressing them into compact tokens for task-conditioned retrieval.

pa:2610.31576.name: What Makes a Good Unmasking Policy? A Controlled Study of Learned Unmasking in Diffusion Language Models
pa:2610.31576.desc: Optimized unmasking policies for masked diffusion language models improve efficiency by using trajectory-contraction targets with confidence and hidden states, achieving better speed-accuracy trade-offs with minimal overhead.

pa:2610.27712.name: RLSplat: Resource-Linear Budget Control for Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
pa:2610.27712.desc: RLSplat enables feed-forward 3D Gaussian splatting with linear reductions in latency, memory, and model size by allocating Gaussians regionally and decoding them via local attention.

pa:2610.25376.name: TILDE: Teacher-in-the-Loop Distillation from Embodied Foundation Models
pa:2610.25376.desc: TILDE distills embodied foundation model capabilities into robot policies via on-policy teacher supervision and autonomous recovery data collection, improving real-world task performance without large-scale action pretraining.

pa:2610.19705.name: RouteWeaver: Weaving Mode Selection and Execution into Unified LLM Routing
pa:2610.19705.desc: RouteWeaver unifies heterogeneous LLM routing modes via coordinated training and progressive exploration, improving accuracy across diverse reasoning tasks.

pa:2610.26233.name: Heartbeat Thinking: Speculative Reasoning and Tool Execution While Listening in Realtime Voice Agents
pa:2610.26233.desc: A heartbeat-style speculative reasoning approach lets voice agents continue preparing tool calls during speech updates, improving coverage and reducing response latency.

pa:2610.24738.name: Editing Images into Reusable Layers via Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation
pa:2610.24738.desc: LayerEditor unifies instruction-guided image editing with reusable RGBA layer generation via joint token modeling and edit-prior distillation, enabling precise local manipulation and layer reuse.
pa:2610.24738.zh: 把單張圖片拆解成可重複使用的透明圖層來編輯
pa:2610.24738.why: 能透過文字指令精準修改圖片局部，並將物件拆開獨立運用，比傳統編輯更靈活

pa:2610.31623.name: F2G-Pose: Geometry-Aware Foundation Feature Lifting for Direct RGB-D Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
pa:2610.31623.desc: F2G-Pose is a real-time feed-forward framework that predicts category-level object pose, metric size, and completed shape from a single RGB-D image using dense visual features, DGCNN tokenization, and a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer.

pa:2610.30320.name: Self-Distilling Future Video Representations for World Action Models
pa:2610.30320.desc: FRED improves single-step future video representations in world action models through self-distillation and temporal conditioning, boosting robot policy performance on long-horizon and unseen tasks.

pa:2610.31651.name: BrickWright: Agentic Creation of Physically Feasible Brick Builds
pa:2610.31651.desc: BrickWright improves physical validity of AI-generated LEGO assemblies by providing agents with an assembly API and feasibility validator, achieving perfect validity while preserving prompt adherence.

pa:2610.27148.name: Who Takes the Lead? Model Ability and Task-Conditioned Collaboration with Humans
pa:2610.27148.desc: Researchers use a shared-control maze to show that stronger language-model agents selectively involve humans based on route advantage rather than failing to collaborate.

pa:2610.30753.name: FilmFlow: Agentic System for 3D Virtual Film Cinematography
pa:2610.30753.desc: FilmFlow is an agentic framework that translates natural-language or video instructions into executable camera trajectories for 3D scenes using specialized director, interpreter, scout, and critic agents, evaluated on the CinemaBench dataset.

pa:2610.31372.name: RIDAR: Safeguarding Research Integrity in Autonomous Research Agents via Automated Detection and Runtime Intervention
pa:2610.31372.desc: RIDAR detects and mitigates research integrity violations in autonomous agents via taxonomy-based post-hoc analysis and real-time intervention.

pa:2610.12586.name: Realism VS Accuracy: Event Sequence Forecasting from a Generative Modeling Perspective
pa:2610.12586.desc: Event sequence forecasting is evaluated as conditional generative modeling, revealing a trade-off between accuracy and realism, and a proposed algorithm converts realism into predictive accuracy.

pa:2610.25835.name: Diffusion Language Models Change Speed Across Tasks and Languages
pa:2610.25835.desc: Diffusion language models spend more computation on novel, rare, or incorrect outputs, and decoding speed can improve inference efficiency and reliability.

pa:2610.31198.name: Different Tasks, Different Timesteps: Temporal Task-Aware Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
pa:2610.31198.desc: T2Quant improves diffusion language model quantization by dynamically allocating activation precision across denoising steps based on predicted task- and time-dependent sensitivity.

pa:2610.24385.name: Bridging Exploration and Persona: Information-Directed Dueling for Test-Time Agent Personalization
pa:2610.24385.desc: ID-TAP uses a neural dueling-bandit framework with similarity-weighted warm starts to adapt LLM agents to user preferences via binary response comparisons within a limited interaction budget.

pa:2610.24383.name: IF-MAP: Influence-Function-Inspired Agent Prioritization in Multi-Agent Systems
pa:2610.24383.desc: IF-MAP identifies high-impact agents in multi-agent LLM systems via prompt perturbation analysis to maximize system-level gains from targeted improvements.

pa:2610.30418.name: Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agentic LLM Systems
pa:2610.30418.desc: LLM agents frequently leak sensitive conclusions assembled from multiple confidential documents, and common safeguards fail to eliminate this mosaic-style disclosure risk.

pa:2610.22722.name: The LLM-Attacker: A Unified Red-Team Framework for Privacy Evaluation of Split and Distributed LLM Systems
pa:2610.22722.desc: LLM-Attacker standardizes privacy evaluations for split language models by recording attacker configurations, enabling comparable scoring of reconstruction attacks, and requiring linked undefended baselines for defense claims.
